description: This file defines the 'Route' class within the FastRoute namespace, representing a route with HTTP method, regex pattern, handler, and variables. It includes methods for constructing a route object and matching a string against the route's regex.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a single route with HTTP method, regex pattern, handler, and route variables, capable of checking if a given string matches the route.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Route object with HTTP method, handler, regex pattern, and variables.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines whether the input string matches the route's regex pattern.
